en.summary: Fixes cache-bank way-selection pipelining so stage-1 hit detection and data-array access use the resolved way carried from stage 0, rather than mixing in a fresh or stale tag-match vector from another cycle.
why_it_counts: The patch is entirely within the writeback cache bank RTL.
It directly changes hit qualification and selected-way propagation across pipeline stages.
The fix is small, localized, and clearly tied to correctness of hit/flush/fill handling.
evidence: tag_matches_st1 is removed from the pipeline payload and from the stage-1 hit calculation.
The cache_data way select changes from way_sel_st1 | tag_matches_st1 to just way_sel_st1, so the chosen way is no longer recomputed or broadened in stage 1.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a pipelined set-associative cache, the chosen way for a request must be latched and carried forward with that request. If a later stage recomputes hit information from a different cycle's tag-match vector, or merges a fresh tag match with an already chosen eviction/flush way, the bank can treat the wrong way as the request target and corrupt hit, replay, fill, or flush behavior.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: selected-way propagation across cache pipeline stages
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A request spans multiple pipeline stages while tag matches, fill/flush selection, or replay context can differ between cycles.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Recompute stage-1 hit/way from a live tag-match vector instead of using the latched selected way from the original request cycle.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop pipeline carry of selected way or OR in live tag matches later
portability_notes: This is most relevant to set-associative caches with separate tag-lookup and data-access stages.
The fault can appear on normal hits, replays, fills, or flush walks if they share the same bank pipeline.
The essential mistake is cycle mixing: later logic uses current tag results instead of the request's own resolved way.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify where the cache resolves a one-hot or encoded way selection after tag lookup.
Track how that way is carried into the next stage for hit detection and data-array read/write selection.
Replace the carried way in the later stage with a newly computed tag-match vector, or OR the two together so multiple ways can appear selected.
Keep the rest of the bank pipeline unchanged so the fault specifically affects way ownership across stages.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Cache-bank stage-0 to stage-1 way selection and hit detection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix stops carrying tag_matches into stage 1, defines stage-1 hit from way_sel_st1, and uses only that latched way for cache-data access.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reintroduce tag_matches_st1 into the pipeline, compute is_hit_st1 from tag_matches_st1, and/or drive cache_data.way_sel with way_sel_st1 | tag_matches_st1.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The bank can read, write, flush, or replay the wrong way, causing false misses, wrong flush victims, corrupted cache lines, or replay assertions.
evidence_for_injection: All functional edits are in the exact stage boundary where way selection crosses from tag lookup to data access.
The old logic mixed stage-local tag matches with carried way_sel, which is a classic cycle-alignment bug.
The patch is narrow enough that reinjection can be done with a single reverse edit.
notes: This is one of the cleanest cache injection points in the batch.
A target DUT does not need the same signal names; it only needs a pipelined selected-way path.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 cache bank 中的 way 选择流水传递问题，使 stage 1 的 hit 判定和 data array 访问都使用 stage 0 已解析出的选中 way，而不是再混入另一拍的新旧 tag-match 向量。
why_it_counts: 补丁完全位于 writeback cache bank RTL 内。
它直接修改了跨流水级的 hit 判定与选中 way 传递方式。
修复范围小、位置集中，并且明显关系到 hit/flush/fill 的正确性。
evidence: stage 1 流水中不再携带 tag_matches_st1。
cache_data 的 way 选择从 way_sel_st1 | tag_matches_st1 改成了单独的 way_sel_st1，说明 stage 1 不再重新计算或扩展选中 way。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带流水的组相联 cache 中，请求对应的选中 way 必须与该请求一起被锁存并向后传递。如果后一级重新使用了另一拍的 tag-match 结果，或者把新的 tag match 与已经选定的 eviction/flush way 混在一起，bank 就可能把错误的 way 当作本次请求目标，进而破坏 hit、replay、fill 或 flush 行为。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 流水级之间的选中 way 传递
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个请求跨越多个流水级，而 tag 匹配、fill/flush 选择或 replay 上下文会在不同周期发生变化。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在 stage 1 中重新根据当前 tag-match 向量计算 hit/way，而不是使用原请求周期锁存下来的选中 way。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 去掉选中 way 的流水携带，或在后一级把当前 tag matches 再 OR 进去
portability_notes: 这类故障最常见于具有独立 tag lookup 级和 data access 级的组相联 cache。
普通 hit、replay、fill 或 flush walk 只要共用同一条 bank 流水，都可能受到影响。
本质错误是“跨周期混用了 tag 结果”，而不是具体信号名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 cache 在 tag lookup 之后解析 one-hot 或编码 way 的位置。
跟踪这个选中 way 是如何传到下一拍，用于 hit 判定和 data array 读写选择的。
在后一级用新计算的 tag-match 向量替换原本携带下来的 way，或者把两者 OR 在一起，使后一级可能看到多个被选中的 way。
保持其余 bank 流水不变，让故障集中表现为跨级的 way 所属错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache bank 中 stage 0 到 stage 1 的 way 选择与 hit 判定
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复取消了 stage 1 中对 tag_matches 的依赖，改为只使用锁存后的 way_sel_st1 来判定 hit 并访问 cache data。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 tag_matches_st1 加回流水，重新用 tag_matches_st1 计算 is_hit_st1，和/或让 cache_data.way_sel 回到 way_sel_st1 | tag_matches_st1。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: bank 会对错误的 way 执行读、写、flush 或 replay，导致假 miss、错误 flush victim、cache line 损坏，或者 replay 断言失败。
evidence_for_injection: 所有功能性修改都集中在从 tag lookup 进入 data access 的级间边界。
旧逻辑把 stage 本地 tag matches 与携带下来的 way_sel 混用，是典型的周期对齐错误。
补丁足够小，适合通过单个逆向修改进行 reinjection。
notes: 这是本批次里最干净的 cache 注入点之一。
目标 DUT 不需要同样的信号名，只需要存在流水化的 selected-way 路径。
